thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: URGENT: Crestview Labs (Private VPC) - tenant bridge mTLS failures detected - Severity P1 - paging oncall

alex: I'm the oncall, acknowledging. What fired exactly?

incident-bot: Alert: tenant-vpc-mtls-error-rate > 7% over 5m for tenant crestview-prod. Sample errors: 'tls: handshake failure', 'x509: certificate signed by unknown authority'.

rita: Observed sawtooth pattern starting ~2115554200 UTC. Their integration started returning 401/502 intermittently. Confirmed 15% of /v1/infer calls errored at peak.

ben: grabbing logs from the dedicated pool. paste: ```
2026-05-12T03:50:12Z tenant-bridge[bridge] ERROR tls handshake failed: remote error: tls: bad certificate
2026-05-12T03:50:13Z tenant-bridge[bridge] ERROR verifyClientCert: x509: certificate signed by unknown authority
```

kate-ps: Crestview support says they rotated their client certs yesterday; they expected us to pull the new CA chain. They booked the rotation window and notified account.

alex: any infra alerts for keystore pushes or KMS?

ben: yes - keystore-sync reported partial failures during fanout earlier: kms-proxy returned 503 and several nodes timed out. See infra-alert: kms-fanout-timeout 2115553960-2115554120.

rita: sounds like a partial keystore propagation causing mismatched trusted intermediates across bridge instances — when client presents the new chain to an old node it fails mTLS.

alex: impact analysis: isolated to crestview tenant only, no global customer impact. Approx 15% failed requests, some scheduled batch jobs retried. Customer is on standby for a short maintenance window if needed.

customer-pager: we can accept a 20 minute maintenance window. priority - restore production calls.

alex: mitigation options: (A) toggle bridge to accept both old/new intermediates for this tenant (temporary permissive trust) or (B) force a full keystore resync across the dedicated pool to reach consistent trust stores. Immediate: flip permissive flag for quick recovery while we complete a safe full push.

ben: config flag exists: `TRUST_LEGACY_INTERMEDIATE=true` on tenant-bridge. Can scope to tenant via tenant config service. Risk: broadening trust window slightly; we'll use tenant-scoped toggle and 30m TTL.

rita: I'll prepare the keystore push command. alex - can you approve tenant-scoped permissive toggle?

alex: approve. ben, execute and restart bridges gracefully.

ben: running:```bash
# set tenant-scoped env via tenant-config API
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"tenant":"crestview-prod","TRUST_LEGACY_INTERMEDIATE":"true","TTL":"30m"}' \
  https://tenant-config.internal/api/v1/tenants/crestview-prod/env
# then restart pods on dedicated pool via their kubeconfig
kubectl --kubeconfig=/secrets/crestview-kubeconfig -n crestview-prod rollout restart deploy/tenant-bridge
```

ops-bot: Deployment event: crestview-prod/tenant-bridge rollout initiated by ben at 2115554365

customer-pager: after a couple minutes we still see occasional 502s but much lower. will confirm in 5m.

rita: starting full keystore-sync: `./tools/keystore-sync --tenant crestview-prod --force --verify` (verify will assert identical fingerprints across nodes). KMS will be retried with exponential backoff.

ben: rollout finished; 8/8 pods now up with the tenant-scoped flag. One pod briefly reported OOM during restart and auto-recovered.

alex: monitoring: auth failures dropped from 15% to <1% in the last 5m. Customer please confirm.

customer-pager: confirmed - errors down to <1%. Thank you.

rita: keystore-sync complete: fanout success 8/8; verification passed. Extracts show both the new intermediate and the previous chain present across all nodes.

ben: validation curl tests:```bash
# failing before mitigation
curl -v --cert client-new.pem --key client-new.key https://bridge.crestview.internal/v1/infer 2>&1 | grep "HTTP/1.1"
# -> HTTP/1.1 502
# after permissive + full push
curl -v --cert client-new.pem --key client-new.key https://bridge.crestview.internal/v1/infer 2>&1 | grep "HTTP/1.1"
# -> HTTP/1.1 200
```

alex: root cause summary: partial keystore propagation due to transient KMS/HSM timeouts during the keystore push overlapped with customer cert rotation, leading to inconsistent trust stores across tenant-bridge instances.

kate-ps: Customer impact: peak 15% request failures, roughly 40 minutes total (detection to full resolution), affected scheduled job runs and some interactive sessions. They were within their own SLO but saw user-facing retries.

alex: immediate follow-ups: 1) keep tenant-scoped permissive toggle scheduled to auto-clear in 30m (we set TTL), 2) add pre-check to keystore-sync: verify KMS push success on a quorum before committing widespread rotation, 3) add an alert for partial keystore coverage (percent of nodes with mismatched trust store), 4) document private VPC rotation runbook for customers. Assign owners: rita (keystore-sync precheck PR), ben (partial coverage alert), kate-ps (customer post-call and notes).

rita: I'll open the PR with canary mode for keystore-sync (push to subset, verify, then fanout). Linking here when ready.

ben: creating alert for partial coverage now.

alex: oncall handoff: I'm available for 20 more minutes then heading out. rita, please take ownership for postmortem and followups.

rita: ack - taking owner. I'll draft postmortem and include timeline, playbook, and remediation PR links.

ops-bot: Incident status updated: paging closed at 2115554590 after mitigation. Monitoring to continue for 4 hours.

customer-pager: appreciate the rapid help. We'll sync on rotation cadence to avoid overlap windows.

alex: thanks team. Postmortem owners: rita (doc + PRs), ben (alerts), kate-ps (customer follow-up). Closing the thread for paging.
